title: Meet your new Board of Directors
blurb: First community board election wraps: David, Will, Stasia, and Ruby stay; JP joins; Joshua remains Treasurer. Hackathon planning and Pebble 2.0 alignment on the agenda.

title: Pebble Plugins preview — biggest SDK change in years
blurb: Headless JS plugins on the phone feed weather, calendar, home control, and more to watchfaces and Index. New permissions model for location and network.

title: Next batch of Round 2s leave the factory
blurb: Production ramping slowly but surely. Keep an eye on order confirmation emails from info@repebble.com.

title: All Time 2 pre-orders shipped — now in stock
blurb: Didn't pre-order? PT2 is on rePebble.com/watch and ships within 48 hours. Color selectors for folks who hadn't locked one in.

title: Pebble Time 2 is in mass production
blurb: 30m water-resistance testing on the line, 20k+ pre-orders, first ships late March 2026. Honest expectations post included.

title: Rebbles in a world with Core
blurb: Shared appstore backend between Rebble and Core Devices. Publish once, reach both ecosystems. Core helps fund Rebble Web Services.

title: See the code that powered the Pebble smartwatches
blurb: Google releases most of classic PebbleOS — the spark that made Core Devices and the hardware comeback possible.

title: Watchfaces run live in the browser
blurb: apps.rePebble.com Top Charts + WASM PebbleOS previews. Battery-impact insights for animated faces.
